normalization: Unicode NFD case-folding with combining marks stripped for comparison only; no source spelling altered in installed output
existing_sources: Pinnow 1959/1960 comparative and Juang records and one later Zoller 2023 record; exact citations preserved in the installed dataset
decision: The Haldar table is a distinct printed compilation from the directly collected Samuells 1856 glossary. The source of Pinnow's individual Juang reflexes is unresolved, so these are not claimed as independent elicitations or merged automatically. Dalton 1866 Appendix F is probably an earlier partial witness of the same Haldar/Dalton list tradition and is excluded from separate installation.
